# Port of lib/pubid/itu/parser.rb — ITU-T/R/D designations: series codes
# (BT/G/V, SGnn), Imp implementation codes, OB Operational Bulletins,
# Reports, Study Group questions (numeric and bracketed series form),
# supplements (Suppl./Amd./Add./Err./Cor. with Technical marker), Annex
# and App. wraps, combined "/XX.N" designations, and the "| twin"
# common-text form. Internal rule `itu_identifier` corresponds to the
# source's `identifier` (renamed: PG forbids self-reference from the
# common-text wrapper).
#
# Edition-2 conversion. Deviations from the v1 tree:
# - every leaf capture body is written out at its site so it lowers to
#   one scalar span: edition 2 materializes bare refs to capture-less
#   composite rules as named nodes (the asme/cie/bsi inlining rule), so
#   `digits`, `yyyymm_year`, `yyyymm_month`, `roman`, `annex_label` and
#   `non_pipe` are spelled out at every capture site, and `letter` (a
#   ref to `upper`) is spelled as its class — a ref chain inside a
#   capture breaks the span lowering. Literal alternations
#   (series_suffix_word, the sector/language/roman_month words) and
#   refs to capture-bearing rules (`number`, `series`, `question_tail`)
#   stay refs and bind as spans.
# - the builder keeps its v1 wrapper walks (`base` recursion for
#   annex/appendix/supplement chains, `combined` ->
#   `designation` elements, `parts` -> `part` hashes), so `base`,
#   `annex_to` and `combined` bind uncast with (raw) and `part` binds
#   through the array (`part -> parts[].part (string)`). The inner
#   `designation` capture is deliberately unbound: it rides inside the
#   raw `combined` array exactly as the v1 tree delivered it.
# - presence markers keep their captured-token shape (the captured
#   space of `supplement_space`/`qualifier_spaced`, the "/BL" of
#   `has_bl`, the "[" of `bracketed`), so the builder's nil? checks
#   keep their meaning; every optional capture is spelled
#   `[ (group) as x ]` so non-participation omits the key on every
#   engine.

grammar PubidItu version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  letter = upper
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  dot = "."
  non_pipe = %x01-7B / %x7D-10FFFF

  itu_prefix = ("Recommendation " "ITU" (dash / space)) / ("ITU" (dash / space))
  sector = ("R" / "T" / "D") as sector
  series = (("SG" 1*digit) / (1*3upper)) as series
  series_group = (upper [1*digit] dash 1*digit) as series
  series_word = space "series" as series_word
  number = (1*digit) as number
  subseries = dot (1*digit) as subseries
  series_suffix_word = "bis" / "ter" / "quater" / "quarter"
  series_suffix = (series_suffix_word) as series_suffix
  series_suffix_spaced = (space as series_suffix_spaced) ((series_suffix_word) as series_suffix)
  qualifier_letter = ((%x41-52 / %x61-72) as qualifier !(upper / lower / digit))
  qualifier_glued = qualifier_letter
  qualifier_spaced = (space as qualifier_spaced) qualifier_letter
  yyyymm_year = ("19" / "20") digit digit
  yyyymm_month = ("0" %x31-39) / ("1" %x30-32)
  yyyymm_shape = yyyymm_year yyyymm_month !digit
  yyyymm_date = dash (("19" / "20") digit digit) as year (("0" %x31-39) / ("1" %x30-32)) as month !digit
  id_status = dash ("I" / "S") !(digit / letter)
  print_id_status = dash "I" !(digit / letter)
  id_date = yyyymm_date [print_id_status]
  document_date = (date_part / id_date)
  rec_word = ("REC" (space / dash))
  publication_id = sector dash "REC" dash series dot code yyyymm_date [id_status] [language]
  code_suffixes = [series_suffix_spaced] [qualifier_spaced]
  attachment = space "attachment" as attachment
  range_end = dash ((1*3upper dot 1*digit) as range_end)
  part = dash !yyyymm_shape (1*digit) as part
  parts = (*part) as parts
  code = imp_code / standard_code
  standard_code = number [series_suffix] [subseries] parts [qualifier_glued]
  imp_code = "Imp" as imp_marker (((1*digit) / (1*3upper)) as number) [subseries] parts
  date_part = space "(" [((1*digit) as month "/")] ((4digit) as year) ")"
  version_part = space ((("(V" 1*digit as version ")") / (("V" / "v") [dot] 1*digit as version)))
  language = dash (("E" / "F" / "A" / "S" / "C" / "R") as language)

  # The combined-designation tail repeats the code-suffix shapes under
  # d_* capture names: a capture name occurring at two structural depths
  # pairs into ONE top-level bound key (last occurrence wins; array
  # bindings concatenate), so the shared number/subseries/parts/suffix/
  # qualifier names would corrupt the primary's Code with the
  # designation's tail. series and number stay shared — the primary
  # always carries them first.
  d_number = (1*digit) as d_number
  d_subseries = dot (1*digit) as d_subseries
  d_part = dash !yyyymm_shape (1*digit) as d_part
  d_parts = (*d_part) as d_parts
  d_series_suffix = (series_suffix_word) as d_series_suffix
  d_series_suffix_spaced = (space as d_series_suffix_spaced) ((series_suffix_word) as d_series_suffix)
  d_qualifier_letter = ((%x41-52 / %x61-72) as d_qualifier !(upper / lower / digit))
  d_qualifier_glued = d_qualifier_letter
  d_qualifier_spaced = (space as d_qualifier_spaced) d_qualifier_letter

  combined_designation = "/" ((series dot d_number [d_subseries] d_parts [d_qualifier_glued] [d_series_suffix_spaced] [d_qualifier_spaced]) as designation)
  combined_suffixes = (1*combined_designation) as combined

  technical_marker = "Technical" as technical space
  supplement_type = (("Suppl." / "Suppl" / "Amd." / "Amd" / "Add." / "Add" / "Err." / "Err") as supplement_type) / (([technical_marker] ("Cor." / "Cor") as supplement_type))
  supplement_number = ([space as supplement_space]) ((1*digit *(dot 1*digit)) as supplement_number)
  supplement_date = space "(" [((1*digit) as supplement_month "/")] ((4digit) as supplement_year) ")"

  base_with_series = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    [rec_word]
    series dot code
    [range_end]
    code_suffixes
    [combined_suffixes]
    [series_word]
    [attachment]
    [version_part]
    [document_date]
  }
  base_without_series = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    code
    code_suffixes
    [attachment]
    [version_part]
    [document_date]
  }
  series_code_body = {
    !("OB" dash)
    ((2*upper) as series)
    (dash as series_dash)
    (((1*digit) / (1*upper)) as number)
    parts
  }
  contribution = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    series
    ("-C" as contribution_marker)
    number
    parts
    [language]
  }
  base_series_code = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    series_code_body
    [version_part]
    [document_date]
  }
  series_code_identifier = base_series_code [language]
  report_word = "Report" as report_marker
  report_body = {
    !("OB" dot)
    [(series dot)]
    code
    [range_end]
    code_suffixes
    [series_word]
    [attachment]
    [version_part]
    [document_date]
  }
  base_report = {
    (report_word space itu_prefix sector space report_body)
    / (itu_prefix sector space report_word space report_body)
  }
  report_identifier = base_report [language]
  base = base_report / base_with_series / base_without_series / base_series_code

  annex_label = upper [1*digit] ["+"]
  annex_body = {
    (base as base)
    space "Annex" space
    ((upper [1*digit] ["+"])) as annex_number
    [document_date]
  }
  annex_identifier = annex_body [language]
  roman = 1*(%x49 / %x56 / %x58)
  appendix_material = space (("test vectors" / "Software") as appendix_material)
  appendix_body = {
    (base as base)
    space "App." [space]
    (1*(%x49 / %x56 / %x58)) as appendix_number
    [appendix_material]
    [document_date]
  }
  appendix_identifier = appendix_body [language]

  supplement_with_base = {
    ((annex_body as base) / (appendix_body as base) / (base as base))
    space supplement_type
    supplement_number
    [supplement_date]
    [language]
  }
  chained_supplement = {
    ((supplement_with_base / supplement_series_only) as base)
    space supplement_type
    supplement_number
    [supplement_date]
    [language]
  }
  supplement_series_only = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    (series_group / series)
    [series_word]
    space supplement_type
    supplement_number
    [supplement_date]
    [language]
  }
  slash_chained_supplement = {
    ((supplement_with_base) as base)
    ("/" as supplement_slash)
    supplement_type
    supplement_number
    [supplement_date]
    [language]
  }
  supplement_identifier = chained_supplement / slash_chained_supplement / supplement_with_base / supplement_series_only

  with_series = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    [rec_word]
    series dot code
    [range_end]
    code_suffixes
    [combined_suffixes]
    [series_word]
    [attachment]
    [version_part]
    [document_date]
    [language]
  }
  without_series = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    code
    code_suffixes
    [attachment]
    [version_part]
    [document_date]
    [language]
  }

  roman_month = "XII" / "XI" / "IX" / "VIII" / "VII" / "VI" / "V" / "IV" / "III" / "II" / "I"
  ob_roman_date = " - " (2digit) as day dot (roman_month as roman_month) dot (4digit) as year
  ob_date = (date_part / ob_roman_date)
  ob_series = "OB" as series
  ob_dot_body = dot number
  ob_no_body = space "No." space number
  ob_bare_body = space number
  ob_with_sector = {
    itu_prefix
    [(sector space)]
    ob_series
    (ob_dot_body / ob_no_body / ob_bare_body)
    [ob_date]
    [language]
  }
  ob_long_form = {
    itu_prefix
    [(sector space)]
    "Operational Bulletin" as _op_bull
    space "No." space number
    [document_date]
    [language]
  }
  special_publication = ob_with_sector / ob_long_form
  annex_to_identifier = "Annex to" space (special_publication as annex_to)
  handbook = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    number dot "HDB" as handbook_marker
    [document_date]
  }
  numeric_question = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    number parts
    (("/" (1*digit) as study_group))
    [(":" as question_colon)]
  }
  question_tail = number [("/BL" as has_bl)] "/" (1*digit) as study_group
  letter_question = {
    itu_prefix sector space
    series dot
    ((("[" as bracketed) question_tail "]") / question_tail)
    [(":" as question_colon)]
  }
  common_text_twin = (space "|" space (1*non_pipe)) as common_text_twin

  identifier = common_text_identifier / itu_identifier
  any_char = %x00-10FFFF
  radio_regulations = {
    itu_prefix
    ("R") as sector
    space "RR" as radio_regulations
    [(date_part / (dash (4digit) as year))]
    [language]
    !any_char
  }
  itu_identifier = {
      annex_to_identifier
    / special_publication
    / supplement_identifier
    / annex_identifier
    / appendix_identifier
    / report_identifier
    / handbook
    / numeric_question
    / letter_question
    / radio_regulations
    / with_series
    / contribution
    / series_code_identifier
    / without_series
    / publication_id
  }
  common_text_identifier = itu_identifier common_text_twin

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    sector -> sector (string)
    series -> series (string)
    series_word -> series_word (string)
    number -> number (string)
    subseries -> subseries (string)
    series_suffix -> series_suffix (string)
    series_suffix_spaced -> series_suffix_spaced (string)
    qualifier -> qualifier (string)
    qualifier_spaced -> qualifier_spaced (string)
    year -> year (string)
    month -> month (string)
    day -> day (string)
    roman_month -> roman_month (string)
    language -> language (string)
    attachment -> attachment (string)
    range_end -> range_end (string)
    part -> parts[].part (string)
    imp_marker -> imp_marker (string)
    version -> version (string)
    series_dash -> series_dash (string)
    combined -> combined (raw)
    technical -> technical (string)
    supplement_type -> supplement_type (string)
    supplement_space -> supplement_space (string)
    supplement_number -> supplement_number (string)
    supplement_month -> supplement_month (string)
    supplement_year -> supplement_year (string)
    base -> base (raw)
    annex_number -> annex_number (string)
    appendix_number -> appendix_number (string)
    appendix_material -> appendix_material (string)
    supplement_slash -> supplement_slash (string)
    report_marker -> report_marker (string)
    _op_bull -> _op_bull (string)
    contribution_marker -> contribution_marker (string)
    handbook_marker -> handbook_marker (string)
    study_group -> study_group (string)
    has_bl -> has_bl (string)
    bracketed -> bracketed (string)
    question_colon -> question_colon (string)
    common_text_twin -> common_text_twin (string)
    annex_to -> annex_to (raw)
    radio_regulations -> radio_regulations (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "ITU-R BT.500"
    accept "Recommendation ITU-T G.650.1 (09/2020)"
    accept "ITU-R SA.3631 Annex A"
    accept "ITU-T OB.101 (2016)"
    accept "Annex to ITU-T OB.101"
    accept "ITU-T E.164/2"
    accept "ITU-T 55/13:"
    accept "ITU-T G.984.2 Amd. 1 (2010)"
    accept "ITU-T G.650.1B"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
